name: Steakhouse / Grill House
description: A premier steak-focused restaurant centered on artisanal butchery, prime aged beef cuts, flame grilling, and elevated fine dining hospitality. Features precise meat doneness selectors, cut weight sizing, sommelier wine cellar pairings, and luxury table service.

sections.name: Appetizers & Starters
sections.description: Opening courses designed to awaken the palate before the main steak cuts. Features classic chophouse soups, crisp salads, cold seafood towers, and decadent small plates.

subSections.name: Soups
subSections.description: Rich Maine lobster bisque, French onion soup gratinated with aged gruyère, and velvety seasonal cream soups.

subSections.name: Salads
subSections.description: Classic iceberg wedge salads, crisp romaine Caesar, vine-ripened beefsteak tomato with burrata, and artisan field greens.

subSections.name: Small Plates
subSections.description: Individual savory starters including prime beef carpaccio, jumbo lump Maryland crab cakes, pan-seared sea scallops, and steak tartare.

subSections.name: Sharing Boards
subSections.description: Communal table centerpieces featuring cured charcuterie, roasted bone marrow with toasted crostini, chilled seafood towers, and artisan cheese selections.

choices.label: Add Crispy Smoked Pork Belly Lardons

sections.name: Premium Steaks & Cuts
sections.description: The signature core of the steakhouse. Showcases certified USDA Prime beef, highly marbled Japanese and Australian Wagyu, salt-brick dry-aged reserve cuts, and monumental house specialties seared in high-temperature ceramic broilers or wood-fired grills. Features comprehensive meat doneness, weight customization, compound butters, and decadent toppings.

subSections.name: USDA Prime Cuts
subSections.description: Top 2% grain-fed American beef cuts including center-cut Filet Mignon, Boneless Ribeye, New York Strip, and Bone-In Kansas City Strip.

subSections.name: Wagyu & Premium
subSections.description: Exceptional BMS 8-12 Japanese A5 Miyazaki Wagyu, Australian Purebred F1 Wagyu strip loins, and heritage breed steaks prized for velvety marbling.

subSections.name: Dry-Aged Selections
subSections.description: In-house butcher-aged cuts rested 28 to 60 days on Himalayan salt blocks to concentrate rich, nutty umami in Porterhouses, Ribeyes, and T-Bones.

subSections.name: House Specialties
subSections.description: Showstopping dining centerpieces such as 32oz Long-Bone Tomahawk steaks, classic Chateaubriand for two, and prime rib cuts carved tableside.

sections.name: Grilled Seafood
sections.description: Fresh ocean fish, whole crustacea, and shellfish flame-broiled or hardwood-grilled. Serves as premier pescatarian main courses and decadent additions to steak cuts.

subSections.name: Fish
subSections.description: Wild Chilean sea bass, King salmon fillets, yellowfin ahi tuna, and whole grilled Mediterranean sea bass (branzino).

subSections.name: Shellfish & Lobster
subSections.description: Live North Atlantic whole lobsters, twin broiled Maine lobster tails, king crab legs, and fire-roasted jumbo sea scallops.

subSections.name: Surf & Turf Additions
subSections.description: Seafood accompaniments tailored to accompany any steak or chop, including split lobster tails, colossal garlic prawns, and crab clusters.

choices.label: Pan-Seared with Brown Butter & Fresh Herbs
Broiled with Lemon, White Wine & Garlic
Medium (Moist, warm translucent center — Recommended for Salmon & Tuna)

sections.name: Poultry & Other Grills
sections.description: Non-beef chargrilled masterworks including organic free-range poultry, Colorado lamb racks, and heritage Berkshire pork chops roasted over wood fire.

subSections.name: Chicken
subSections.description: Brick-pressed organic half chicken, rosemary rotisserie supreme breast, and wood-fired chicken with herb-infused crispy skin.

subSections.name: Lamb
subSections.description: Dijon and herb-crusted Colorado lamb racks, thick-cut double loin lamb chops, and grilled lamb skewers.

subSections.name: Pork
subSections.description: Thick-cut bone-in Berkshire pork chops, slow-roasted cider glazed pork belly, and tenderloin medallions.

choices.label: Medium Rare (Warm red center — Recommended for Lamb, 57°C / 135°F)
Medium (Warm pink center — Recommended for Berkshire Pork, 63°C / 145°F)

sections.name: Sides
sections.description: Essential steakhouse accompaniments served family-style or individually. Built around classic steakhouse potatoes, creamed greens, roasted wild mushrooms, and artisanal mac & cheese, along with extra ramekins of compound butters and rich reductions.

subSections.name: Classic Steakhouse Sides
subSections.description: Idaho jumbo baked potatoes, creamed spinach with nutmeg, hand-cut russet fries, garlic mashed potatoes, and grilled asparagus spears.

subSections.name: Premium Sides
subSections.description: Maine lobster mac & cheese, sautéed wild chantrelles and morels, duck fat roasted fingerling potatoes, and creamed sweet corn with crispy pancetta.

subSections.name: Sauces & Butters
subSections.description: Individual gravy boats of peppercorn cognac sauce, béarnaise, red wine demi, truffle butter disks, and horseradish cream.

choices.label: Fully Loaded (Applewood Bacon, Aged Cheddar, Chives & Sour Cream)
Drizzled White Truffle Oil & Shaved Reggiano

sections.name: Desserts
sections.description: Indulgent after-dinner finales including warm oven soufflés, rich tortes, classic steakhouse cheesecakes, and an artisanal cheese board designed to accompany port and digestifs.

subSections.name: Hot Desserts
subSections.description: Baked-to-order Valrhona dark chocolate soufflé, warm molten chocolate lava cake, cast-iron apple crisp, and caramelized brioche pudding.

subSections.name: Cold Desserts
subSections.description: Classic New York cheesecake with macerated berry compote, vanilla bean crème brûlée, artisanal gelato, and refreshing fruit sorbets.

subSections.name: Cheese Board
subSections.description: Sommelier's selection of aged artisan cheeses (Comté, Roquefort, Triple-Cream Brillat-Savarin, Truffle Pecorino) with honeycomb, Marcona almonds, and walnut toast.

choices.label: Madagascar Vanilla Bean Ice Cream Scoop
Add Glass of Taylor Fladgate 10-Year Tawny Port

sections.name: Wine List
sections.description: The foundational beverage pillar of the steakhouse. Comprehensive sommelier-curated wine cellar specializing in full-bodied red wines, bold Napa Cabernets, Premier Cru Bordeaux, crisp coastal whites, and vintage Champagnes. Supports extensive glass, carafe, half-bottle, and bottle service with vintage designations.

subSections.name: Red Wines
subSections.description: Bold Napa Valley, Sonoma, and Bordeaux Cabernet Sauvignons, Argentine Malbecs, Italian Brunellos and Barolos, and Burgundy Pinot Noirs curated to pair with marbled steaks.

subSections.name: White Wines
subSections.description: Oak-matured Chardonnays, crisp Sancerre and Sauvignon Blancs, Chablis Premier Cru, and dry Rieslings matching seafood and white meats.

subSections.name: Rosé
subSections.description: Dry Provence and Bandol rosé selections featuring crisp mineral acidity and red summer fruit aromatics.

subSections.name: Sparkling & Champagne
subSections.description: Grand Cru Champagnes, vintage Cuvées, Franciacorta, and sparkling wines for celebratory dining and toasts.

sections.name: Cocktails
sections.description: Premium craft mixology program rooted in classic chophouse traditions. Highlights spirit-forward Old Fashioneds, smoked Manhattan variations, bone-dry martinis, seasonal innovations, and herbal digestifs to bookend the dining journey.

subSections.name: Classic Cocktails
subSections.description: Timeless steakhouse standards including Barrel-Aged Old Fashioned, Smoked Black Cherry Manhattan, Vesper Martini, Sazerac, and Negroni.

subSections.name: Signature Cocktails
subSections.description: House mixologist originals incorporating wagyu-washed bourbon, smoked rosemary, flamed citrus oils, and rare bitters.

subSections.name: Digestifs & After-Dinner
subSections.description: Calvados, Amari, Grappa, single-estate Cognacs, and Irish coffee preparations designed for post-meal digestion.

Upgrade to Single-Barrel Cask Strength Spirit

sections.name: Beers & Spirits
sections.description: Extensive liquor cabinet emphasizing vintage bourbons, single-malt scotches, rare ryes, and craft draft and bottled beers that pair with hearty charbroiled steaks and ribs.

subSections.name: Draft Beer
subSections.description: Fresh chilled draft pours including crisp pilsners, nitrogen-poured dry stouts, Belgian ales, and hazy IPAs.

subSections.name: Bottled Beer
subSections.description: Imported Trappist ales, Bavarian lagers, craft stouts, cider, and premium non-alcoholic beers in chilled glassware.

subSections.name: Whiskey & Bourbon
subSections.description: Extensive whiskey library featuring Kentucky straight bourbons, wheated bourbons, high-ryes, and Islay & Speyside single malts.

subSections.name: Other Spirits
subSections.description: Aged sipping rums, 100% blue agave tequilas, artisanal mezcals, craft London dry gins, and filtered vodkas.

choices.label: Served over Large Crystal Ice Sphere
Served with Spring Water Dropper on Side
With Premium Club Soda & Lemon Twist

sections.name: Non-Alcoholic
sections.description: Sophisticated alcohol-free offerings for designated drivers, health-conscious guests, and business luncheons. Features artisan zero-proof botanical mocktails, premium sparkling and still mineral waters, handcrafted sodas, and specialty roasted coffees and teas.

subSections.name: Mocktails
subSections.description: Zero-proof mixology drinks made with distilled non-alcoholic botanicals, fresh citrus, smoked herbal reductions, and craft ginger brew.

subSections.name: Soft Drinks
subSections.description: House-made lemonade, Mexican cane sugar sodas, craft ginger beer, and freshly brewed unsweetened iced tea.

subSections.name: Water
subSections.description: Imported volcanic sparkling and natural spring waters in 750ml glass bottles (San Pellegrino, Acqua Panna).

subSections.name: Hot Beverages
subSections.description: Barista-pulled espresso, Americano, cappuccino, macchiato, and premium loose-leaf whole-flower teas.

choices.label: Chilled with Fresh Lemon & Lime Wedges

sections.name: Set Menus & Experiences
sections.description: Multi-course prix fixe culinary journeys, curated date-night feasts, express corporate lunches, and intimate Chef's Table tasting menus. Provides seamless course selections and sommelier wine pairings for elevated dining occasions.

subSections.name: Tasting Menu
subSections.description: A 5-course signature culinary progression featuring seafood starters, prime dry-aged tastings, Japanese Wagyu, and dessert.

subSections.name: Couple's Dinner
subSections.description: Complete romantic dinner for two including shared shellfish appetizer, 32oz Tomahawk or Chateaubriand steak, two family sides, and warm chocolate soufflé.

subSections.name: Business Lunch
subSections.description: Prompt two or three-course lunch menu formatted for executive dining with guaranteed swift kitchen pacing.

subSections.name: Chef's Table
subSections.description: Exclusive VIP dining experience directly overlooking the charcoal kitchen with custom bespoke cuts, live carving, and rare vintage pairings.

choices.label: No Wine Pairing (A La Carte Beverages)
Prestige Grand Cru & Library Reserve Pairing (3 Paired Glasses)

timeBehavior.note: Business Lunch available Monday–Friday 12:00–15:00; Chef's Table and Tasting Menus available during dinner service.

sections.name: Seasonal & Chef's Specials
sections.description: Limited-quantity butcher market cuts, seasonal luxury catches, truffles, and allocated cellar reserves uncorked by the glass. Changes periodically based on butcher availability and seasonal harvest.

subSections.name: Rare & Limited Cuts
subSections.description: Extremely limited cuts including 60-day bourbon-barrel aged ribeyes, authentic Olive Wagyu from Kagawa Prefecture, and special farm-allocated prime steers.

subSections.name: Seasonal Market Features
subSections.description: Fresh harvest seasonal specialties including wild Alaskan King crab, white Alba truffle features, and roasted game.

subSections.name: Sommelier Cellar Allocations
subSections.description: Back-vintage collectible wines, single-barrel distillery bourbon picks, and allocated library bottles poured via Coravin.

systemFeatures.name: Meat Doneness Selection
systemFeatures.description: Mandatory steak and grilled meat cooking temperatures communicated directly to the kitchen ticket system with detailed temperature and tenderness guidelines.

systemFeatures.name: Age Verification
systemFeatures.description: Enforces digital age gate verification for ordering alcohol-containing beverages including wine cellar selections, craft cocktails, beers, and spirits.

systemFeatures.name: Wine Metadata & Cellar Attributes
systemFeatures.description: Structured wine cellar attributes including vintage, region, country, grape varietal, alcohol by volume (ABV), body, and sommelier tasting notes.

systemFeatures.name: Allergen & Dietary Badging
systemFeatures.description: Displays clear allergen alerts (dairy, gluten, shellfish, nuts) and dietary preferences (keto, paleo, gluten-free, halal) across all steakhouse courses.

systemFeatures.name: Real-Time Cut & Inventory Badges
systemFeatures.description: Shows real-time status for limited-availability dry-aged cuts, daily butcher allocations, and sold-out items to prevent ordering unavailable steaks.

systemFeatures.name: Set Menus & Dining Experiences
systemFeatures.description: Supports multi-course tasting menus, prix fixe business lunches, and couple's date-night packages with required course selection and wine pairing add-ons.

systemFeatures.name: Serving Size & Weight Sizing
systemFeatures.description: Multi-tier cut weight customization (oz/grams) for prime steaks, pour sizes for wines and spirits, and individual vs. table sharing portions for sides and appetizers.
